chunks: A section on discourse regarding the Occultation: Know that we have two paths in discussing the occultation of the Master of the Age (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الْغَيْبَةِ: Occultation (the state of being hidden from public view)
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ: Master of the Age (a title for Imam al-Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What are the two paths for discussing the occultation of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi introduces this section by outlining two primary methodological approaches to discussing the occultation of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.), reflecting the nuanced scholarly discourse of the Twelver Shia tradition. This framework sets the stage for addressing theological and historical complexities surrounding the Hidden Imam, distinguishing between different interpretive lenses used by early scholars. It highlights the structured intellectual engagement with the concept of ghaybah, which is central to Shia eschatology and jurisprudence.
